accuracy.method: sheet edges anchored to the AUDA bbox published by townplanmap.com
accuracy.caveat: Not survey control. The reference bbox is hand-entered and internally anisotropic by 0.5%, which accumulates to roughly 365 m at the far north/south edges of this 70 km sheet. Verified good near the centre (~10-20 m at z16). Replace with surveyed control points before any parcel-level legal use.
improvement_paths: least-squares fit against the place names burned into the scan (MOTERA, BHAT, HANSOL, ASARVA, RAMOL, SANAND, ...)
request the georeferenced original or a GeoPDF from AUDA
